role: Gate: drives the native populate for the probe's dimension (overworld populate driver, ChunkProviderHell.populate, or BiomeEndDecorator) call by call against the oracle's PopulateProbe, checking structure intersect counts, every stage marker's Random state and write index, the write stream, tile entity deltas, pending scheduled ticks and the final region with light and height maps.

structs.name: omark
structs.java: an oracle stage marker (stage, Random seed, write index)

structs.name: oent
structs.java: an oracle-recorded entity (e.g. the End dragon)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/populate. Native calls: populate_init, populate_offer_chunk, populate_initial_chunks, populate_seed, populate_stage_now, populate_structures, populate_structures_count, populate_lakes, populate_dungeons, populate_150809_p, populate_freeze, populate_map_size (csrc/engine/populate.h), populate_hell_init/offer_chunk/structures/count/free, populate_end_ores, populate_end_spike, populate_end_dragon (populate_nether.h), decorator_decorate, randomtick_tick_rand, ticks_*, te_render, trace_*. Negative mutations --negative=count, snow, muttree, maporder, village, helreseed, spike each must fail naming the call and stage. Structure blocks come from the native halves (mineshaft_blocks.c and siblings over structure_blocks.c), walked in java.util.HashMap order. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/PopulateProbe.java. Recordings under out/java/populate (pop21, pop210, pop211, hell2, hell42, hellsmoke, endsmoke, endsmoke42 and more). WorldGenSpikes path assumed; the checker verifies it exists.
